# Data preparation
```{r Import PATH data}
# Load PATH Wave 8 Youth data
load("Wave8_Youth_DATA/DS8002/36498-8002-Data.rda")
youth <- da36498.8002

# Load PATH Wave 8 Adult / Young Adult data
load("Wave8_YA_DATA/DS8001/36498-8001-Data.rda")
adult <- da36498.8001

# Create young adult sample from adult data
ya <- adult[adult$R08R_A_AGECAT6 == "(1) 1 = 18 to 24 years old", ]
```
```{r Recode PATH}
# Recode susceptibility: 1 = lowest susceptibility, 4 = highest susceptibility
recode_sus <- function(x) {
  x_num <- as.numeric(x)
  ifelse(is.na(x_num), NA, 5 - x_num)
}

# Harmonized PATH Youth susceptibility variables
PATH_youth_sus <- youth %>%
  dplyr::transmute(
    source = "PATH",
    dataset = "PATH youth",
    group = "Youth",

    # Nicotine pouches
    np_curious  = recode_sus(R08_YA1103NP),
    np_nextyear = recode_sus(R08_YA1206NP),
    np_soon     = recode_sus(R08_YA1104NP),
    np_friend   = recode_sus(R08_YA1105NP),

    # Cigarettes
    cig_curious  = recode_sus(R08_YC1103),
    cig_nextyear = recode_sus(R08_YC1206),
    cig_soon     = recode_sus(R08_YC1104),
    cig_friend   = recode_sus(R08_YC1105),

    # E-cigarettes / ENDS
    ecig_curious  = recode_sus(R08_YV1103),
    ecig_nextyear = recode_sus(R08_YV1206),
    ecig_soon     = recode_sus(R08_YV1104),
    ecig_friend   = recode_sus(R08_YV1105),

    # Hookah

    hookah_nextyear = recode_sus(R08_YH1206),
    hookah_soon     = recode_sus(R08_YH1104),

    # Snus

    snus_soon     = recode_sus(R08_YU1104),
```

```{r Define products}
# Product item sets
product_items <- list(
  np = c("np_curious", "np_nextyear", "np_soon", "np_friend"),
  cig = c("cig_curious", "cig_nextyear", "cig_soon", "cig_friend"),
  ecig = c("ecig_curious", "ecig_nextyear", "ecig_soon", "ecig_friend"),
  hookah = c("hookah_curious", "hookah_nextyear", "hookah_soon", "hookah_friend"),
  snus = c("snus_curious", "snus_nextyear", "snus_soon", "snus_friend"),
  smkls = c("smkls_curious", "smkls_nextyear", "smkls_soon", "smkls_friend"),
  cigar = c("cigar_curious", "cigar_nextyear", "cigar_soon", "cigar_friend"),
  cigarillo = c("cigarillo_curious", "cigarillo_nextyear", "cigarillo_soon", "cigarillo_friend"),
  fcigar = c("fcigar_curious", "fcigar_nextyear", "fcigar_soon", "fcigar_friend")
)

# All broad susceptibility item names
broad_sus_items <- unname(unlist(product_items))

# Respondents with at least one susceptibility response (sample-flow denominator)
PATH_broad_sus <- PATH_sus_wide %>%
  dplyr::select(source, dataset, group, dplyr::all_of(broad_sus_items))

PATH_broad_sus_analytic <- PATH_broad_sus %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    rowSums(!is.na(dplyr::select(., dplyr::all_of(broad_sus_items)))) > 0
  )

# Product order and publication labels used throughout the primary analyses
product_labels <- c(
  np = "Nicotine pouches",
  cig = "Cigarettes",
  ecig = "E-cigarettes",
  hookah = "Hookah",
  smkls = "Smokeless tobacco",
  snus = "Snus",
  cigar = "Traditional cigars",
  cigarillo = "Cigarillos",
  fcigar = "Filtered cigars"
)

product_items_main <- product_items[names(product_labels)]
broad_sus_items_main <- unname(unlist(product_items_main))
stopifnot(all(broad_sus_items_main %in% names(PATH_broad_sus_analytic)))
```
```{r Analytic sample}
curiosity_items <- vapply(
  product_items_main,
  function(items) items[grepl('_curious$', items)],
  character(1)
)

PATH_never9 <- PATH_broad_sus_analytic %>%
  filter(
    rowSums(!is.na(dplyr::select(., all_of(curiosity_items)))) ==
      length(curiosity_items)
  )

# Preserve original four response categories for descriptives and practical scores.
PATH_never9_original <- PATH_never9

#Combine categories 3 and 4 for every indicator so
PATH_never9_model <- PATH_never9
PATH_never9_model[broad_sus_items_main] <- lapply(
  PATH_never9_model[broad_sus_items_main],
  function(x) dplyr::case_when(
    is.na(x) ~ NA_real_,
    x == 1 ~ 1,
    x == 2 ~ 2,
    x %in% c(3, 4) ~ 3
  )
)
PATH_never9_model$group <- factor(
  PATH_never9_model$group,
  levels = c('Youth', 'Young adult')
)

sample_flow <- data.frame(
  sample = c(
    'At least one susceptibility response',
    'Never users of all nine included products',
    'Never users with all 36 responses complete'
  ),
  total = c(
    nrow(PATH_broad_sus_analytic),
    nrow(PATH_never9_original),
    sum(complete.cases(PATH_never9_original[, broad_sus_items_main]))
  ),
  youth = c(
    sum(PATH_broad_sus_analytic$group == 'Youth'),
    sum(PATH_never9_original$group == 'Youth'),
    sum(PATH_never9_original$group == 'Youth' & complete.cases(PATH_never9_original[, broad_sus_items_main]))
  ),
  young_adult = c(
    sum(PATH_broad_sus_analytic$group == 'Young adult'),
    sum(PATH_never9_original$group == 'Young adult'),
    sum(PATH_never9_original$group == 'Young adult' & complete.cases(PATH_never9_original[, broad_sus_items_main]))
  )
)

write.csv(sample_flow, file.path(analysis_dir, 'sample_flow.csv'), row.names = FALSE)
print(sample_flow)

# Original four-category descriptives for Table 1.
item_descriptives <- lapply(broad_sus_items_main, function(item) {
  x <- PATH_never9_original[[item]]
  counts <- table(factor(x, levels = 1:4))
  data.frame(
    item = item,
    n = sum(!is.na(x)),
    mean = mean(x, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd = sd(x, na.rm = TRUE),
    response_1 = as.integer(counts[1]),
    response_2 = as.integer(counts[2]),
    response_3 = as.integer(counts[3]),
    response_4 = as.integer(counts[4]),
    skewness = psych::skew(x, na.rm = TRUE),
    kurtosis = psych::kurtosi(x, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
}) %>% bind_rows()
write.csv(item_descriptives, file.path(analysis_dir, 'table1_item_descriptives.csv'), row.names = FALSE)
```

# Confirmatory factor models
```{r CFA models}
# CFA model syntax.
product_factor_model <- '
  np_sus =~ np_curious + np_nextyear + np_soon + np_friend
  cig_sus =~ cig_curious + cig_nextyear + cig_soon + cig_friend
  ecig_sus =~ ecig_curious + ecig_nextyear + ecig_soon + ecig_friend
  hookah_sus =~ hookah_curious + hookah_nextyear + hookah_soon + hookah_friend
  snus_sus =~ snus_curious + snus_nextyear + snus_soon + snus_friend
  smkls_sus =~ smkls_curious + smkls_nextyear + smkls_soon + smkls_friend
  cigar_sus =~ cigar_curious + cigar_nextyear + cigar_soon + cigar_friend
  cigarillo_sus =~ cigarillo_curious + cigarillo_nextyear + cigarillo_soon + cigarillo_friend
  fcigar_sus =~ fcigar_curious + fcigar_nextyear + fcigar_soon + fcigar_friend
'

general_factor_model <- paste0(
  product_factor_model,
  '\n  general_sus =~ np_sus + cig_sus + ecig_sus + hookah_sus + ',
  'snus_sus + smkls_sus + cigar_sus + cigarillo_sus + fcigar_sus\n'
)

one_factor_model <- paste0(
  'general_sus =~ ',
  paste(broad_sus_items_main, collapse = ' + ')
)

bifactor_model <- paste0(
  'general_sus =~ ', paste(broad_sus_items_main, collapse = ' + '), '\n',
  'np_specific =~ ', paste(product_items_main$np, collapse = ' + '), '\n',
  'cig_specific =~ ', paste(product_items_main$cig, collapse = ' + '), '\n',
  'ecig_specific =~ ', paste(product_items_main$ecig, collapse = ' + '), '\n',
  'hookah_specific =~ ', paste(product_items_main$hookah, collapse = ' + '), '\n',
  'smkls_specific =~ ', paste(product_items_main$smkls, collapse = ' + '), '\n',
  'snus_specific =~ ', paste(product_items_main$snus, collapse = ' + '), '\n',
  'cigar_specific =~ ', paste(product_items_main$cigar, collapse = ' + '), '\n',
  'cigarillo_specific =~ ', paste(product_items_main$cigarillo, collapse = ' + '), '\n',
  'fcigar_specific =~ ', paste(product_items_main$fcigar, collapse = ' + '), '\n',
  'general_sus ~~ 0*np_specific + 0*cig_specific + 0*ecig_specific + 0*hookah_specific + ',
  '0*smkls_specific + 0*snus_specific + 0*cigar_specific + 0*cigarillo_specific + 0*fcigar_specific\n',
  'np_specific ~~ 0*cig_specific + 0*ecig_specific + 0*hookah_specific + 0*smkls_specific + 0*snus_specific + 0*cigar_specific + 0*cigarillo_specific + 0*fcigar_specific\n',
  'cig_specific ~~ 0*ecig_specific + 0*hookah_specific + 0*smkls_specific + 0*snus_specific + 0*cigar_specific + 0*cigarillo_specific + 0*fcigar_specific\n',
  'ecig_specific ~~ 0*hookah_specific + 0*smkls_specific + 0*snus_specific + 0*cigar_specific + 0*cigarillo_specific + 0*fcigar_specific\n',
  'hookah_specific ~~ 0*smkls_specific + 0*snus_specific + 0*cigar_specific + 0*cigarillo_specific + 0*fcigar_specific\n',
  'smkls_specific ~~ 0*snus_specific + 0*cigar_specific + 0*cigarillo_specific + 0*fcigar_specific\n',
  'snus_specific ~~ 0*cigar_specific + 0*cigarillo_specific + 0*fcigar_specific\n',
  'cigar_specific ~~ 0*cigarillo_specific + 0*fcigar_specific\n',
  'cigarillo_specific ~~ 0*fcigar_specific\n'
)

fit_cfa <- function(model, data = PATH_never9_model) {
  lavaan::cfa(
    model = model,
    data = data,
    ordered = broad_sus_items_main,
    estimator = 'WLSMV',
    missing = 'pairwise'
  )
}

cat('Fitting one-factor CFA\n'); flush.console()
fit_one_factor_h <- fit_cfa(one_factor_model)
cat('Fitting correlated product CFA\n'); flush.console()
fit_product_factors_h <- fit_cfa(product_factor_model)
cat('Fitting higher-order CFA\n'); flush.console()
fit_general_factor_h <- fit_cfa(general_factor_model)
cat('Fitting bifactor CFA\n'); flush.console()
fit_bifactor_h <- fit_cfa(bifactor_model)

fit_metrics <- c(
  'chisq.scaled', 'df.scaled', 'pvalue.scaled',
  'cfi.scaled', 'tli.scaled', 'rmsea.scaled',
  'rmsea.ci.lower.scaled', 'rmsea.ci.upper.scaled', 'srmr'
)

extract_fit <- function(fit, label) {
  values <- lavaan::fitMeasures(fit, fit_metrics)
  value_frame <- as.data.frame(as.list(as.numeric(values)))
  names(value_frame) <- names(values)
  cbind(
    data.frame(model = label, n = sum(lavaan::lavInspect(fit, 'nobs'))),
    value_frame
  )
}

cfa_fit_table <- bind_rows(
  extract_fit(fit_one_factor_h, 'One factor'),
  extract_fit(fit_product_factors_h, 'Nine correlated product factors'),
  extract_fit(fit_general_factor_h, 'Higher order'),
  extract_fit(fit_bifactor_h, 'Bifactor')
)
write.csv(cfa_fit_table, file.path(analysis_dir, 'table2_cfa_fit.csv'), row.names = FALSE)
print(cfa_fit_table)

saveRDS(fit_product_factors_h, file.path(analysis_dir, 'fit_product_factors.rds'))
saveRDS(fit_general_factor_h, file.path(analysis_dir, 'fit_general_factor.rds'))
saveRDS(fit_bifactor_h, file.path(analysis_dir, 'fit_bifactor.rds'))
```
```{r Product-specific scales}
# Product-specific CFA fit, categorical omega, and Mokken H.
product_scale_results <- lapply(names(product_items_main), function(prod) {
  items <- product_items_main[[prod]]
  dat <- PATH_never9_model %>% dplyr::select(all_of(items)) %>% tidyr::drop_na()
  model <- paste0(prod, '_sus =~ ', paste(items, collapse = ' + '))
  fit <- lavaan::cfa(model, data = dat, ordered = items, estimator = 'WLSMV')
  h <- mokken::coefH(as.data.frame(dat))
  fm <- lavaan::fitMeasures(fit, c('cfi.scaled', 'tli.scaled', 'rmsea.scaled', 'srmr'))
  data.frame(
    product = prod,
    product_label = unname(product_labels[prod]),
    n = nrow(dat),
    cfi = unname(fm['cfi.scaled']),
    tli = unname(fm['tli.scaled']),
    rmsea = unname(fm['rmsea.scaled']),
    srmr = unname(fm['srmr']),
    ordinal_omega = unname(semTools::compRelSEM(fit, ord.scale = TRUE)[1]),
    scale_H = as.numeric(h$H[1])
  )
}) %>% bind_rows()

write.csv(product_scale_results, file.path(analysis_dir, 'product_scale_results.csv'), row.names = FALSE)
print(product_scale_results)

# Observed product-scale descriptives, observed score correlations, latent
# factor correlations, and standardized higher-order loadings.
latent_cor_matrix <- lavaan::lavInspect(fit_product_factors_h, 'cor.lv')
latent_cor_table <- as.data.frame(as.table(latent_cor_matrix)) %>%
  rename(factor_1 = Var1, factor_2 = Var2, correlation = Freq) %>%
  filter(as.numeric(factor_1) > as.numeric(factor_2)) %>%
  arrange(desc(correlation))
write.csv(latent_cor_table, file.path(analysis_dir, 'latent_product_correlations.csv'), row.names = FALSE)

# Product-specific scale scores use the same three-category item coding as the
# primary ordinal models. The supplementary matrix places ordinal omega on the
# diagonal, latent-factor correlations above the diagonal, and observed
# Spearman correlations below the diagonal.
product_order <- names(product_items_main)
factor_order <- paste0(product_order, '_sus')
score_names <- paste0(product_order, '_score')

product_score_data <- PATH_never9_model
for (prod in product_order) {
  product_score_data[[paste0(prod, '_score')]] <- rowMeans(
    product_score_data[, product_items_main[[prod]]],
    na.rm = FALSE
  )
}

observed_score_matrix <- product_score_data[, score_names]
observed_spearman <- cor(
  observed_score_matrix,
  use = 'pairwise.complete.obs',
  method = 'spearman'
)
latent_cor_ordered <- latent_cor_matrix[factor_order, factor_order]
omega_lookup <- setNames(product_scale_results$ordinal_omega, product_scale_results$product)

supplementary_matrix <- matrix(
  NA_real_,
  nrow = length(product_order),
  ncol = length(product_order),
  dimnames = list(product_order, as.character(seq_along(product_order)))
)
for (i in seq_along(product_order)) {
  for (j in seq_along(product_order)) {
    supplementary_matrix[i, j] <- if (i == j) {
      omega_lookup[product_order[i]]
    } else if (i > j) {
      observed_spearman[i, j]
    } else {
      latent_cor_ordered[i, j]
    }
  }
}

subscale_descriptives <- lapply(seq_along(product_order), function(i) {
  prod <- product_order[i]
  values <- observed_score_matrix[[paste0(prod, '_score')]]
  data.frame(
    scale_number = i,
    product = prod,
    product_label = unname(product_labels[prod]),
    n = sum(!is.na(values)),
    mean = mean(values, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd = sd(values, na.rm = TRUE),
    median = median(values, na.rm = TRUE),
    iqr = IQR(values, na.rm = TRUE),
    percent_at_minimum = 100 * mean(values == 1, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
}) %>% bind_rows()

table_s1 <- bind_cols(
  subscale_descriptives,
  as.data.frame(supplementary_matrix, check.names = FALSE)
)

write.csv(
  table_s1,
  file.path(analysis_dir, 'tableS1_subscale_descriptives_reliability_correlations.csv'),
  row.names = FALSE
)
write.csv(
  observed_spearman,
  file.path(analysis_dir, 'observed_product_score_spearman_correlations.csv'),
  row.names = TRUE
)
print(table_s1)

higher_order_loadings <- lavaan::standardizedSolution(fit_general_factor_h) %>%
  filter(lhs == 'general_sus', op == '=~') %>%
  transmute(
    product_factor = rhs,
    product = str_remove(rhs, '_sus$'),
    product_label = unname(product_labels[product]),
    standardized_loading = est.std,
    se = se,
    pvalue = pvalue
  )
write.csv(higher_order_loadings, file.path(analysis_dir, 'higher_order_loadings.csv'), row.names = FALSE)
```

```{r Measurement invariance}
# Age-group invariance of the higher-order model.
# Two next-year items had no category-3 endorsements among young adults even
# after the common 3/4 collapse. For invariance only, dichotomize those two
# items (lowest response versus any higher response) in both age groups.
PATH_never9_invariance <- PATH_never9_model
binary_invariance_items <- c('smkls_nextyear', 'cigarillo_nextyear')
PATH_never9_invariance[binary_invariance_items] <- lapply(
  PATH_never9_invariance[binary_invariance_items],
  function(x) ifelse(is.na(x), NA_real_, ifelse(x == 1, 1, 2))
)

cat('Fitting configural invariance model\n'); flush.console()
fit_config_h <- lavaan::cfa(
  model = general_factor_model,
  data = PATH_never9_invariance,
  group = 'group',
  ordered = broad_sus_items_main,
  estimator = 'WLSMV',
  missing = 'pairwise'
)
cat('Fitting loadings-plus-thresholds invariance model\n'); flush.console()
fit_constrained_h <- lavaan::cfa(
  model = general_factor_model,
  data = PATH_never9_invariance,
  group = 'group',
  ordered = broad_sus_items_main,
  estimator = 'WLSMV',
  missing = 'pairwise',
  group.equal = c('loadings', 'thresholds')
)

invariance_fit <- bind_rows(
  extract_fit(fit_config_h, 'Configural'),
  extract_fit(fit_constrained_h, 'Loadings + thresholds')
)
invariance_fit$delta_cfi <- c(NA, invariance_fit$cfi.scaled[2] - invariance_fit$cfi.scaled[1])
invariance_fit$delta_tli <- c(NA, invariance_fit$tli.scaled[2] - invariance_fit$tli.scaled[1])
invariance_fit$delta_rmsea <- c(NA, invariance_fit$rmsea.scaled[2] - invariance_fit$rmsea.scaled[1])
invariance_fit$delta_srmr <- c(NA, invariance_fit$srmr[2] - invariance_fit$srmr[1])
lrt <- as.data.frame(lavaan::lavTestLRT(fit_config_h, fit_constrained_h))
invariance_fit$delta_chisq <- c(NA, lrt$`Chisq diff`[2])
invariance_fit$delta_df <- c(NA, lrt$`Df diff`[2])
invariance_fit$delta_pvalue <- c(NA, lrt$`Pr(>Chisq)`[2])
write.csv(invariance_fit, file.path(analysis_dir, 'table3_invariance.csv'), row.names = FALSE)
print(invariance_fit)
```

```{r graded-response-models-and-information-figures, cache=TRUE}
# Product-specific three-category graded response models.
cat('Fitting product-specific GRMs\n'); flush.console()
fit_product_grm_h <- lapply(names(product_items_main), function(prod) {
  items <- product_items_main[[prod]]
  dat <- PATH_never9_model %>% dplyr::select(all_of(items)) %>% tidyr::drop_na()
  fit <- mirt::mirt(dat, model = 1, itemtype = 'graded', verbose = FALSE)
  list(product = prod, product_label = unname(product_labels[prod]), n = nrow(dat), items = items, fit = fit)
})
names(fit_product_grm_h) <- names(product_items_main)

grm_parameter_table <- lapply(fit_product_grm_h, function(x) {
  p <- as.data.frame(mirt::coef(x$fit, IRTpars = TRUE, simplify = TRUE)$items) %>%
    tibble::rownames_to_column('item')
  p %>% mutate(product = x$product, product_label = x$product_label, n = x$n)
}) %>% bind_rows() %>%
  mutate(item_type = case_when(
    str_detect(item, '_curious$') ~ 'Curious',
    str_detect(item, '_friend$') ~ 'Best friend offered',
    str_detect(item, '_soon$') ~ 'Try soon',
    str_detect(item, '_nextyear$') ~ 'Use in next year',
    TRUE ~ item
  )) %>%
  dplyr::select(product, product_label, n, item, item_type, a, b1, b2)
write.csv(grm_parameter_table, file.path(analysis_dir, 'table4_grm_parameters.csv'), row.names = FALSE)
print(grm_parameter_table)

# Information curves and within-product brief-form comparisons.
theta_values <- seq(-3, 4, by = .05)
theta_matrix <- matrix(theta_values)
information_results <- lapply(fit_product_grm_h, function(x) {
  item_names <- rownames(mirt::coef(x$fit, IRTpars = TRUE, simplify = TRUE)$items)
  info <- vapply(seq_along(item_names), function(i) {
    mirt::iteminfo(mirt::extract.item(x$fit, i), Theta = theta_matrix)
  }, numeric(length(theta_values)))
  colnames(info) <- item_names
  ny <- which(str_detect(item_names, '_nextyear$'))
  ts <- which(str_detect(item_names, '_soon$'))
  full <- rowSums(info)
  wide <- data.frame(
    product = x$product,
    product_label = x$product_label,
    theta = theta_values,
    full_information = full,
    full_standard_error = 1 / sqrt(full),
    nextyear_trysoon_information = rowSums(info[, c(ny, ts), drop = FALSE]),
    nextyear_information = info[, ny],
    trysoon_information = info[, ts]
  )
  long <- wide %>%
    dplyr::select(product, product_label, theta, ends_with('information')) %>%
    pivot_longer(ends_with('information'), names_to = 'form', values_to = 'information') %>%
    mutate(form = dplyr::recode(
      form,
      full_information = 'Full four-item scale',
      nextyear_trysoon_information = 'Next year + try soon',
      nextyear_information = 'Next year only',
      trysoon_information = 'Try soon only'
    ))
  list(wide = wide, long = long)
})

information_wide <- bind_rows(lapply(information_results, `[[`, 'wide'))
information_long <- bind_rows(lapply(information_results, `[[`, 'long')) %>%
  mutate(
    product_label = factor(product_label, levels = unname(product_labels[names(product_items_main)])),
    form = factor(form, levels = c('Full four-item scale', 'Next year + try soon', 'Next year only', 'Try soon only'))
  )

information_peaks <- information_wide %>%
  group_by(product, product_label) %>%
  slice_max(full_information, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  transmute(
    product, product_label,
    maximum_information = full_information,
    theta_at_maximum_information = theta,
    minimum_standard_error = full_standard_error
  )

information_retention <- information_long %>%
  filter(theta >= 0, theta <= 3) %>%
  group_by(product, product_label, form) %>%
  summarise(mean_information_theta_0_to_3 = mean(information), .groups = 'drop') %>%
  group_by(product, product_label) %>%
  mutate(percent_full_information_retained = 100 * mean_information_theta_0_to_3 /
           mean_information_theta_0_to_3[form == 'Full four-item scale']) %>%
  ungroup()
write.csv(information_peaks, file.path(analysis_dir, 'product_information_peaks.csv'), row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(information_retention, file.path(analysis_dir, 'brief_form_information_retention.csv'), row.names = FALSE)

make_info_se_panel <- function(dat) {
  dat <- dat %>% mutate(se_display = pmin(full_standard_error, 2))
  sf <- max(dat$full_information) / 2
  ggplot(dat, aes(theta)) +
    geom_line(aes(y = full_information, linetype = 'Test information'), color = 'black', linewidth = .9) +
    geom_line(aes(y = se_display * sf, linetype = 'Standard error'), color = 'gray45', linewidth = .9) +
    scale_y_continuous('Information', sec.axis = sec_axis(~ . / sf, name = 'Standard error')) +
    scale_linetype_manual(values = c('Test information' = 'solid', 'Standard error' = 'dashed'), name = NULL) +
    coord_cartesian(xlim = c(-1, 4)) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 10) +
    theme(legend.position = 'bottom', panel.grid.minor = element_blank(), plot.title = element_text(size = 10, hjust = .5)) +
    labs(title = unique(dat$product_label), x = expression(theta))
}

info_panels <- split(information_wide, factor(information_wide$product, levels = names(product_items_main))) %>%

make_brief_information_panel <- function(dat, show_y_title = FALSE) {

# Supplementary Figure S1: option characteristic curves for try-soon items.
# The two sparse upper response categories were combined in the primary
# three-category graded response models.
trysoon_occ_data <- lapply(fit_product_grm_h, function(x) {
  item_names <- rownames(mirt::coef(x$fit, IRTpars = TRUE, simplify = TRUE)$items)
  trysoon_index <- which(str_detect(item_names, '_soon$'))
  probabilities <- mirt::probtrace(
    mirt::extract.item(x$fit, trysoon_index),
    Theta = theta_matrix
  )
  colnames(probabilities) <- c(
    'Definitely not',
    'Probably not',
    'Probably or definitely yes'
  )
  as.data.frame(probabilities) %>%
    mutate(theta = theta_values) %>%
    pivot_longer(
      -theta,
      names_to = 'response_category',
      values_to = 'response_probability'
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      product = x$product,
      product_label = x$product_label,
      response_category = factor(
        response_category,
        levels = c('Definitely not', 'Probably not', 'Probably or definitely yes')
      )
    )
}) %>% bind_rows()

write.csv(
```

# General scoring and short-form sensitivity analyses
```{r general-scoring-and-short-form-sensitivity-analyses, cache=TRUE}
# Practical nine-subscale composite among complete 36-item respondents.
complete36 <- PATH_never9_original %>% filter(complete.cases(.[, broad_sus_items_main]))
for (prod in names(product_items_main)) {
  complete36[[paste0(prod, '_score')]] <- rowMeans(complete36[, product_items_main[[prod]]])
}
score_names <- paste0(names(product_items_main), '_score')
score_matrix <- complete36[, score_names]
z_matrix <- scale(score_matrix)
weight_lookup <- setNames(higher_order_loadings$standardized_loading, paste0(higher_order_loadings$product, '_score'))
weights <- weight_lookup[score_names]
score_comparison <- data.frame(
  equal_weight_raw = rowMeans(score_matrix),
  equal_weight_standardized = rowMeans(z_matrix),
  loading_weighted_standardized = as.numeric(z_matrix %*% weights / sum(weights))
)

score_model <- paste0('general_score =~ ', paste(score_names, collapse = ' + '))
fit_score <- lavaan::cfa(score_model, data = complete36, estimator = 'MLR')
score_results <- data.frame(
  n = nrow(complete36),
  omega = unname(semTools::compRelSEM(fit_score, ord.scale = FALSE, return.df = FALSE)[1]),
  standardized_alpha = psych::alpha(score_matrix, check.keys = FALSE, warnings = FALSE)$total$std.alpha,
  raw_vs_loading_weighted = cor(score_comparison$equal_weight_raw, score_comparison$loading_weighted_standardized),
  equal_vs_loading_weighted = cor(score_comparison$equal_weight_standardized, score_comparison$loading_weighted_standardized),
  cfi_robust = fitMeasures(fit_score, 'cfi.robust'),
  tli_robust = fitMeasures(fit_score, 'tli.robust'),
  rmsea_robust = fitMeasures(fit_score, 'rmsea.robust'),
  srmr = fitMeasures(fit_score, 'srmr')
)
write.csv(score_results, file.path(analysis_dir, 'general_composite_results.csv'), row.names = FALSE)
print(score_results)

# Exploratory short-form CFA models in the harmonized sample.
nextyear_items <- paste0(names(product_items_main), '_nextyear')
```

```{r sensitivity-typical-binary-coding, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Sensitivity analysis using the conventional susceptibility coding:
# the lowest response indicates no susceptibility; every higher response indicates susceptibility.
PATH_never9_sensitivity <- PATH_never9_original
PATH_never9_sensitivity[broad_sus_items_main] <- lapply(
  PATH_never9_sensitivity[broad_sus_items_main],
  function(x) dplyr::case_when(
    is.na(x) ~ NA_real_,
    x == 1 ~ 0,
    x %in% 2:4 ~ 1
  )
)

fit_sensitivity_cfa <- function(model) {
  lavaan::cfa(
    model = model,
    data = PATH_never9_sensitivity,
    ordered = broad_sus_items_main,
    estimator = 'WLSMV',
    missing = 'pairwise'
  )
}

fit_sensitivity_one_factor <- fit_sensitivity_cfa(one_factor_model)
fit_sensitivity_product_factors <- fit_sensitivity_cfa(product_factor_model)
fit_sensitivity_higher_order <- fit_sensitivity_cfa(general_factor_model)
fit_sensitivity_bifactor <- fit_sensitivity_cfa(bifactor_model)

# The bifactor fit indices are descriptive only when the solution is inadmissible.
binary_bifactor_parameters <- lavaan::parameterEstimates(fit_sensitivity_bifactor)
binary_bifactor_negative_variances <- binary_bifactor_parameters[
  binary_bifactor_parameters$op == '~~' &
    binary_bifactor_parameters$lhs == binary_bifactor_parameters$rhs &
    binary_bifactor_parameters$est < 0,
  c('lhs', 'est', 'se', 'pvalue')
]
print(binary_bifactor_negative_variances)

sensitivity_cfa_table <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  extract_fit(fit_sensitivity_one_factor, 'One factor; binary coding'),
  extract_fit(fit_sensitivity_product_factors, 'Nine correlated product factors; binary coding'),
  extract_fit(fit_sensitivity_higher_order, 'Higher order; binary coding'),
  extract_fit(fit_sensitivity_bifactor, 'Bifactor; binary coding (inadmissible)')
)

print(sensitivity_cfa_table)
write.csv(
  sensitivity_cfa_table,
  file.path(getwd(), 'table_sensitivity_cfa_binary_coding.csv'),
  row.names = FALSE
)
```

# Sampling-weight sensitivity analysis
```{r sensitivity-wave8-sampling-weights, message=FALSE}
# This compares weighted and unweighted CFA fits in the SAME subset. The Wave 8
# Wave 7-cohort single-wave weights are available for 3,617 of the 3,769
# participants in the primary analytic sample. This is a fit sensitivity check,
# not a full complex-survey analysis: PATH replicate weights are not used here.

# Recover PERSONID in the row order of the harmonized primary model data.
youth_in_model <- rowSums(!is.na(PATH_youth_sus[, curiosity_items])) == length(curiosity_items)
ya_in_model <- rowSums(!is.na(PATH_ya_sus[, curiosity_items])) == length(curiosity_items)
weight_sensitivity_ids <- c(
  as.character(youth$PERSONID[youth_in_model]),
  as.character(ya$PERSONID[ya_in_model])
)
stopifnot(
  length(weight_sensitivity_ids) == nrow(PATH_never9_model),
  !anyNA(weight_sensitivity_ids),
  !anyDuplicated(weight_sensitivity_ids),
  identical(
    as.character(PATH_never9_model$group),
    c(rep('Youth', sum(youth_in_model)), rep('Young adult', sum(ya_in_model)))
  )
)

read_path_weights <- function(path) {
  weight_env <- new.env(parent = emptyenv())
  object_name <- load(path, envir = weight_env)
  stopifnot(length(object_name) == 1L)
  weight_env[[object_name]]
}
path_youth_weights <- read_path_weights(
  'ICPSR_36498 2/DS8232/36498-8232-Data.rda'
)
path_adult_weights <- read_path_weights(
  'ICPSR_36498/DS8231/36498-8231-Data.rda'
)
stopifnot(
  all(c('PERSONID', 'R08_Y_S07WGT') %in% names(path_youth_weights)),
  all(c('PERSONID', 'R08_A_S07WGT') %in% names(path_adult_weights)),
  !anyDuplicated(as.character(path_youth_weights$PERSONID)),
  !anyDuplicated(as.character(path_adult_weights$PERSONID))
)

n_youth_model <- sum(youth_in_model)
youth_weight_row <- match(
  weight_sensitivity_ids[seq_len(n_youth_model)],
  as.character(path_youth_weights$PERSONID)
)
adult_weight_row <- match(
  weight_sensitivity_ids[seq.int(n_youth_model + 1L, length(weight_sensitivity_ids))],
  as.character(path_adult_weights$PERSONID)
)
path_single_wave_weight <- c(
  as.numeric(as.character(path_youth_weights$R08_Y_S07WGT[youth_weight_row])),
  as.numeric(as.character(path_adult_weights$R08_A_S07WGT[adult_weight_row]))
)

weight_sensitivity_data <- PATH_never9_model
weight_sensitivity_data$path_single_wave_weight <- path_single_wave_weight
weight_sensitivity_data <- weight_sensitivity_data[
  is.finite(weight_sensitivity_data$path_single_wave_weight) &
    weight_sensitivity_data$path_single_wave_weight > 0,
]
stopifnot(nrow(weight_sensitivity_data) == 3617L)

weight_sensitivity_models <- list(
  'One factor' = one_factor_model,
  'Nine correlated product factors' = product_factor_model,
  'Higher order' = general_factor_model,
  'Bifactor' = bifactor_model
)
weight_sensitivity_rows <- list()
for (weighting in c('Unweighted matched subset', 'Weighted matched subset')) {
  for (model_name in names(weight_sensitivity_models)) {
    cat('Fitting', weighting, '-', model_name, '\n'); flush.console()
    model_syntax <- weight_sensitivity_models[[model_name]]
    if (weighting == 'Weighted matched subset') {
      fit <- lavaan::cfa(
        model = model_syntax,
        data = weight_sensitivity_data,
        ordered = broad_sus_items_main,
        estimator = 'WLSMV',
        missing = 'pairwise',
        sampling.weights = 'path_single_wave_weight'
      )
    } else {
      fit <- lavaan::cfa(
        model = model_syntax,
        data = weight_sensitivity_data,
        ordered = broad_sus_items_main,
        estimator = 'WLSMV',
        missing = 'pairwise'
      )
    }
    fit_row <- extract_fit(fit, model_name)
    fit_parameters <- lavaan::parameterEstimates(fit)
    fit_row$negative_variances <- sum(
      fit_parameters$op == '~~' &
        fit_parameters$lhs == fit_parameters$rhs &
        fit_parameters$est < 0,
      na.rm = TRUE
    )
    fit_row$converged <- lavaan::lavInspect(fit, 'converged')
    fit_row$weighting <- weighting
    weight_sensitivity_rows[[length(weight_sensitivity_rows) + 1L]] <- fit_row
  }
}
weight_sensitivity_cfa_table <- dplyr::bind_rows(weight_sensitivity_rows) %>%
  dplyr::select(
    weighting, model, n,
    cfi.scaled, tli.scaled, rmsea.scaled, srmr,
    negative_variances, converged
  )
print(weight_sensitivity_cfa_table)
write.csv(
  weight_sensitivity_cfa_table,
  file.path(analysis_dir, 'sensitivity_cfa_sampling_weights.csv'),
  row.names = FALSE
)
```
